name: ChargeHub
description:
ChargeHub connects Claude to the widest range of EV charging networks across North America. Ask for chargers near an address, a detour on a road trip, or a hotel with charging on site, and Claude can search the area and report back what's actually there — how fast it charges, what it plugs into, what it costs, and whether the ports are free right now.

Key features

- Search by location — find charging stations around any latitude/longitude point, returned closest-first with the distance to each one.
- Filter to what your car can use — narrow by charging network, connector type, charging level, and minimum power in kW, so a CCS driver never gets a list of Tesla-only posts.
- Filter to what you need — free charging only, 24/7 public access only, hotels and lodging, or stations with specific amenities nearby.
Live port status — pull the full record for a single station: street address, connector groups, per-port availability, pricing, and access instructions.
A link to every station — each result carries a link to that station's page on chargehub.com, so you can open the map, photos, and user reports yourself.
- English and French — request either language for station names, descriptions, and links.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ChargeHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ChargeHub to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.chargehub.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is ChargeHub MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, ChargeHub scores 100/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ChargeHub MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ChargeHub provides these MCP tools: get_charging_location_details, get_charging_locations_radius, and get_charging_networks.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ChargeHub?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ChargeHub in travel on the Manufact MCP catalog include Inbin Pulse, PLAZA Hotels, Point Hacks, Skimetric, and TiCATi.
ChargeHub does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
ChargeHub is developed by ChargeHub. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
